verdict.rationale: Fivetran syncs data to open table formats in data lakes and offers a REST API for programmatic access, giving some data portability, but this is an ETL destination-sync tool rather than a full user-controlled export/leave workflow — there's no documented one-click 'export everything and delete my account' capability, and data lives in whatever warehouse/lake the customer already owns rather than being packaged for departure. missing for 10: an explicit bulk export/account-data-portability mechanism, documentation of full open-format coverage for ALL connectors (not just lake sync), and any offboarding/data-takeout guarantee.
